answer: Bonded endorsement gate. A key joins the reward set only with E signatures from distinct member credentials; each endorser vets, locks C in a vault burned by a fraud proof against the endorsed key, and signs at most b applicants per epoch. So an ocean of anonymous keys can't flood in; with M members the set grows like a dune, at most b·M new keys per epoch. n clones need nE endorsements priced ≥ expected slash p·C per epoch, so cloning pays only while per-key reward exceeds E·p·C. Weak spots: clean clones make p≈0; admitted clones gain endorse budget, so growth compounds — slowed, not stopped.
